fact: Benin's digital agency ASIN, in a June 2026 bulletin, proposes a governance framework for generative-AI use in public administration, including sovereign hosting of data on national infrastructure or equivalent, contractual reversibility and full data return, and a ban on transfers to Cloud Act or FISA jurisdictions.

Decree 2026-579 of 2 September 2026 created a National Digital Committee under the President, with protection of strategic data among its priorities and a mandate to give a prior opinion on technology partnerships that could engage national digital sovereignty.
